description: NOAA's Climate Change Web Portal—Oceans and Marine Ecosystems is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Cooperative Institute for Research in Environmental Science (CIRES); NOAA | Earth System Research Laboratory | Physical Sciences Division; NOAA Fisheries. Display or download climate projection output for Land and Rivers across the globe. Projections are from the 5th phase of the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project ( CMIP5 ) that informed the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report. A similar portal offers CMIP5 projections focused on Land and Rivers. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Heat, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
